details.original_topic_guidance: Group items by the event or condition that appears to have triggered the problem, such as after a recent update, policy change, office move, access change, rollback, or system sync event. Use this when the ticket text points to a likely precipitating change.

details.original_topic_guidance: Group tickets by where they occur in an end-to-end journey, such as pre-start onboarding, day-one setup, ongoing operations, or post-change follow-up. Use cues like orientation, new hire setup, pay stubs, launch prep, and transfer requests to place items.

details.original_topic_guidance: Organize tickets by the specific way something is going wrong, such as missing information, locked/inaccessible item, duplicate record, mismatch/discrepancy, delay/stall, or broken synchronization. This should ignore business ownership and focus on symptom shape.
